channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Treasures of the Lydian legacy
item.description: The Aegean region of Türkiye is always associated with the sea — the mighty, mythological Aegean Sea.

item.title: Türkiye condemns Israel’s death penalty move - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye has vehemently denounced the Israeli parliament’s decision to approve legislation imposing the death penalty on Palestinians.

item.title: Iran vows 'crushing' attacks on US after Trump threats - World News
item.description: Iran on April 2 threatened "crushing" attacks on the U.S. and Israel, firing missiles at Tel Aviv after U.S. President Donald Trump vowed to bomb the Islamic republic "back to the Stone Ages.”

item.title: Gas source diversification gives Türkiye flexibility, says energy minister - Latest News
item.description: Türkiye maintains a supply network of more than 10 different countries for its natural gas imports, a strategy that Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar credits with providing the nation with immense operational flexibility.

item.title: Marmaris gears up for leading presidential cycling tour - Türkiye News
item.description: Preparations are underway in the southwestern province of Muğla’s Marmaris as the coastal resort town gears up to host three key stages of the 61st Presidential Cycling Tour of Türkiye, the country's premier road cycling race.

item.title: World Bank official 'extremely concerned' over Iran war fallout - Latest News
item.description: The World Bank is "extremely concerned" about the effect the war on Iran will have on inflation, jobs and food security, and is in talks with member states on how to address immediate needs in the crisis, a top official has told AFP.

item.title: Oil rallies, stocks drop as Trump dampens Mideast hopes - Latest News
item.description: Oil surged and stocks fell on Thursday after Donald Trump threatened further heavy strikes on Iran, and offered no solution to reopening the key Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Exports decline, trade deficit widens by 57 percent in March - Latest News
item.description: The conflict in the Middle East weighed on Türkiye’s trade performance in March, as exports fell, imports rose, and the foreign trade deficit expanded.

item.title: Türkiye collects 75 pct of stray animals, minister says - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye has collected around 75 percent of its stray animals as part of a nationwide campaign launched following the enactment of recent legal regulations, Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi has said.

item.title: Armenia cannot be in both EU and Russian customs bloc, Putin says - World News
item.description: Armenia cannot be both a member of the European Union and the Russian-led Eurasian Economic Union, President Vladimir Putin told Armenia's Prime Minister on April 1, amid tensions over Yerevan's pivot towards the West.

item.title: Anger in France over Trump's Macron dig that wife treats him 'badly' - World News
item.description: Donald Trump sparked anger in France on Thursday after making fun of the French president and his wife, imitating a French accent and saying Emmanuel Macron's wife "treats him extremely badly".

item.title: Türkiye to continue its active role in Black Sea security - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye will continue to take initiatives for maintaining peace and stability in the Black Sea and implement the Montreux Convention, the defense ministry has said, informing that a new maritime command to be set in Istanbul will serve as part of the decisions taken by the Collation of the Willing for Ukraine.

item.title: AKP spox downplays Özel's calls for by-elections - Türkiye News
item.description: The ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) spokesman on April 1 downplayed calls by the main opposition leader to push for by-elections, citing regional and international tensions as a reason.

item.title: Turkish Cyprus condemns attacks on citizens at border area - Türkiye News
item.description: Turkish Cypriot President Tufan Erhürman released a statement on April 1 condemning an attack by certain groups from the Greek Cypriot Administration who targeted civilians sitting in a park near the border area dividing the capital Nicosia.

item.title: Erdoğan says water could be the next global conflict - Türkiye News
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on April 2 that water could become the focus of global conflicts in the coming era, much like oil and carbon fuels were in the past and stressed the need for careful management of Türkiye's water resources.
